name: Tokatee (a Cascade valley course on the McKenzie River)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours), same keys as pnw.json. Tokatee Golf Club, McKenzie Bridge, in the old-growth forest of the McKenzie River valley below the Three Sisters (course chat, 2026-11-13). From the OSIP 2024 summer photo (fairway #89916d, green #9fa26d, bunker #b4a98c, water #4b7a6f): mown turf a warm olive green, greens a little yellower, the rough between the holes drier and goldener; bunker sand grey-tan (volcanic); the ponds and creeks the clear emerald-teal of McKenzie water. Trees: towering Douglas fir and western red cedar (two dark conifer tones by variant), with vine maple, black cottonwood and red alder among them (trees_tokatee.py; a drawing choice, the lidar gives only crown shape). Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
